summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical process of deploying analytics services (MOPs) to a staging environment. Initial attempts required using `helm upgrade` with specific versioning and namespace details (`allunite/mops`, `-n staging`). It was noted that the service name for staging changed from `mops-staging` to simply `staging`. The process involved updating Kubernetes configuration via AWS CLI commands (e.g., `aws eks update-kubeconfig`) and ensuring access to the correct Helm repository (`s3://allunite-helm-charts/`). Multiple deployment attempts were made, requiring specific version tags from the develop branch of MOPs. Finally, someone confirmed that the staging deployment was successful.
decisions: The analytics service (MOPs) must be deployed to staging using `helm upgrade` commands.
The Helm repository for allunite charts is located at `s3://allunite-helm-charts/`.
